title: LiveClipper 2026.7.15.2
notes:
Signed Runtime V3 incremental update from 2026.7.15.1 to 2026.7.15.2.

- Fix settings persistence and activation reliability.
- Add multi-industry category support, including mother-and-baby and pet profiles, plus mix source-group management and video thumbnails.
- Bundle and verify the fixed WebView2 runtime and ffmpeg/ffprobe tools so extracted packages retain the desktop window and media processing on clean PCs.
- Keep launcher 1.1.0 and updater 1.3.0 unchanged.
